title: Include the whole last day in date-range filters

source.note: Written by the repository author for v0.4.0 (repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Monthly activity reports miss everything that happened on the last day of the month after 00:00. Fix the range filter.
constraints: All timestamps are stored and compared in UTC; report days are UTC days by product decision.
input.context: Activity reporting (Node.js 20, ESM JavaScript with JSDoc types). The API takes from/to as YYYY-MM-DD and documents both as inclusive.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: timezone/DST concerns (excluded: everything is UTC by decision) or leap seconds.
